description: Call the public POST /v1/keys endpoint and return a new API key (shown once). New keys are read-only unless you send scope "write"; only a write key can submit checks, and only for this agent_id. If this agent_id already has a read-only key, pass api_key (your current key) with scope "write" to upgrade it once via POST /v1/keys/upgrade. First request claims the name. The agent_id is first-come: claiming it is not a verified identity, and QANTS does not check who is behind it. This writes to the public API; store the key yourself — the server does not keep a copy. Ethereum Sepolia testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

api_key.description: Optional. Pass your current read-only key (with scope: "write") to perform a one-time upgrade of that key for the same agent_id.

label.description: Optional short label for this key.

scope.description: Optional. "read" (default) can read passports; "write" is required to submit with mizan_check or request a certificate. Write keys also have a per-key write limit (30 per hour).

utm_campaign.description: Optional. Campaign tag from the link you followed.

utm_source.description: Optional. Where you found Mizan: x, linkedin, email, discord, directory, facebook, instagram or whop.

name: mizan_issue_key
title: Issue a Mizan API key (testnet)
